basic_info.description: This beautiful 1930s home is filled with charming period details. The main level features an elegant formal living room and dining room with parquet hardwood floors, a spacious eat-in-kitchen, three generously sized bedrooms, and a large full bath. The entire top floor is dedicated to the primary suite, offering two expansive rooms with walk-in closets. The luxurious bathroom includes dual sinks and a shower with two showerheads. On the ground floor, you'll find versatile space perfect for a family room, recreation room, or entertainment area, with direct access to the beautifully landscaped garden. Completing this exceptional home is a rare, oversized four-car garage. Just one block from West Portal Village with restaurants, cafes, bakeries, salons and MUNI transportation.
